title: Northbridge Payments (Fintech) - Customer Case Study (Q4 2025)
author: Sofia Ivanova
body:
## Summary
Northbridge Payments is a fintech company building fraud and dispute workflows for card issuers. This customer story highlights how Redwood Inference helped the team deliver AI-assisted operations features with predictable performance.

**Customer:** Northbridge Payments
**Industry segment:** Fintech
**Asset type:** Case study
**Publication quarter:** Q4 2025

## Outcomes (high level)
- More consistent responsiveness during weekly traffic spikes
- Faster root-cause isolation using standardized performance dashboards
- Clear upgrade path from self-serve to more predictable capacity

## Seller notes
Lead with: reliability + operational visibility for customer-facing workflows.
